panel.name: panel_prop_mover
panel.text: Right-click an object > Director > Path Object, or select it and press Enroll. Move the prop, drop nodes, then Drive.

button.label: Enroll selected object
button.name: btn_enroll
button.tool_tip: Enroll the in-world selection's linkset ROOT as a drivable prop (select it with right-click or the edit tool first)

button.label: Remove
button.name: btn_remove
button.tool_tip: Un-enroll the selected prop. Its authored path is dropped too

scroll_list.name: prop_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Enrolled props. The name fills in from the object's properties (fetched when you selected it); away = the object is not currently resolvable (out of interest range or derezzed)

button.label: Add node here
button.name: btn_node_add
button.tool_tip: Append a path node at the prop's CURRENT position (drag the prop with the edit tool between adds to lay out the route)

button.label: Delete node
button.name: btn_node_del
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected node (the last node when none is selected)

button.label: Clear path
button.name: btn_node_clear
button.tool_tip: Stop the drive and drop every node of the selected prop (it stays enrolled)

scroll_list.name: node_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: The selected prop's path nodes. Select one to tune its skid yaw and speed override below

spinner.label: Skid (deg)
spinner.name: node_skid_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Yaw offset from the travel direction as the drive passes the selected node: fake a skid or drift through a corner. + is counter-clockwise

spinner.label: m/s
spinner.name: node_speed_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Local speed override at the selected node (0 = use the path speed). Ramp node speeds to fake acceleration or braking

spinner.label: Path m/s
spinner.name: path_speed_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Nominal drive speed along the whole path (per-node overrides win locally)

combo_box.name: end_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What happens at the last node: hold there, loop back to the start, or ping-pong the route

button.label: Drive
button.name: btn_drive
button.tool_tip: Drive the selected prop along its path (needs at least 2 nodes). Client-side only: other viewers see the prop parked

button.label: Stop
button.name: btn_stop
button.tool_tip: Release the selected prop's drive; it stays rendered where the drive left it until the next server update

button.label: Drive all
button.name: btn_drive_all
button.tool_tip: Drive every enrolled prop that has a drivable path

check_box.label: Show paths in world
check_box.name: show_paths_check
check_box.tool_tip: Draw every enrolled prop's path in world (ribbon, chevrons and numbered nodes, tinted per prop) while a mover floater is open. Shared with the avatar path preview
